title: Northgate Optical Lens Design Price Schedule
content:
Northgate Optical makes every pair of prescription eyewear as one eyewear job, and the lens design ordered on the job is its tier. The base lens price below is the price of one pair of lenses of that design in standard plastic, with scratch-resistant coating and UV protection.

| Lens design (tier) | Optical design | Prescription it is ordered on | Base lens price (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | single vision | a valid single vision prescription | 39.99 |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | lined bifocal | a valid multifocal prescription with an add power | 69.99 |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | lined trifocal | a valid multifocal prescription with an add power | 89.99 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | standard progressive | a valid multifocal prescription with an add power | 99.99 |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | premium progressive | a valid multifocal prescription with an add power | 149.99 |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | digital freeform progressive | a valid multifocal prescription with an add power, issued within the design's prescription age limit | 199.99 |

Every lens design is ordered under an active membership.

### Reading the schedule

- The base lens price is the lens charge for the design itself. A lens material other than standard plastic, and an anti-reflective, light-adaptive or blue-light filtering treatment, are priced on their own schedules and are not part of this figure.
- The designs are listed in rank order, from Northgate Single Vision Lenses (rank 1) to Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses (rank 6).

### Price comparison between designs (illustrative)

When two designs are compared, the difference in base lens price is read straight from the table. For example, Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses (149.99) and Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses (99.99) differ by 50.00; Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses (199.99) and Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses differ by 50.00; Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses (89.99) and Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses (69.99) differ by 20.00.
